write_env_variables_to_json: write all environment variables to a JSON file in the specified output directory
create_env_snapshot: create a JSON snapshot of the current environment variables for debugging or logging
dump_env_to_file: dump the current process environment variables into a formatted JSON file
review_env_variables: review the current environment variables by exporting them to a JSON file
summarize_env_state: summarize the current environment state by writing all variables to a JSON file
